tagline: What your home really costs to run and build, from official data

contact_form._help: Web3Forms access key (free, web3forms.com). Messages reach your inbox and no email address is shown on the site. Leave empty to show contact_email instead.

_content_updated_help: Change this date when you edit texts or calculators. It becomes the sitemap date of pages that do not depend on EIA data.

ads._help: Paste the code your ad network gives you. head_html goes inside <head>. Slots are optional placements on every page. Leave everything empty to run without ads.

partners._help: Affiliate or partner links. A button appears only where its url starts with https://. Every button is marked rel=sponsored and shows the disclosure line. solar_quotes: solar calculator and state solar sections. electricity_plans: the 14 places where homes can choose a supplier; state_urls overrides the url for one state, for example {"TX": "https://..."}. contractor_quotes: under the result of the calculators listed.
partners.disclosure: Partner link: we may earn a commission if you use it. It never changes the numbers on this page.

solar_quotes.label: Compare solar quotes from local installers

analytics._help: Cloudflare Web Analytics needs no cookie banner. GA4 is needed later for Journey by Mediavine.

site_verification._help: Ownership checks from affiliate networks (FlexOffers, Impact...) or any other service. meta_tags: paste each <meta ...> tag exactly as given; it goes in the <head> of every page. files: file name -> exact content, written at the site root (for example {"flexoffers123.txt": "abc"}).
